title: Signal Router
description: Count signal paths through a device network with required waypoints.
writeup:
## Approach

Devices form a directed acyclic graph (DAG). Each device routes signals to one or more downstream devices.

## Part 1

BFS from the source device, counting every time a signal reaches the `out` node. Each path through the DAG is counted separately.

## Part 2

Count only paths that pass through specific required intermediate devices. DFS with memoisation tracks which required nodes have been visited as a frozen set in the state. Only paths that visit all required nodes before reaching `out` are counted.
